messages:
cara: opened a small PR to update halcyon-7b model card with compatibility notes for q4_cpu variants and add tiny SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6128

cara: problem: q4_cpu variants can disable the KV cache for large contexts and silently fall back to disk-cache workers; users saw higher tail latency and different billing behavior. Request: (1) add a compatibility row listing affected variants, (2) paste quick p95 bench numbers for 4k/16k contexts, (3) short Python + JS snippets showing routing hints and fallback detection.

devon: runtime note: correct. q4_cpu disables on-GPU KV cache above ~8k to avoid OOM on host-mapped builds; fallback path emits `kernel.fallback_reason`. Recommend doc wording: "KV cache: not available on halcyon-7b-q4_cpu variants for contexts >8k; streaming may fallback to disk-cache worker (see kernel.fallback_reason)."

cara: pasted bench numbers (ctx=4096 p95 tokens/sec q4_cpu:2.1 t/s, fp16:7.0 t/s; ctx=16384 q4_cpu falls back and tail latency ~3.8x). Added compatibility row and linked catalog fallback table.

nora: small lint: anchor "compatibility" collides with other cards. please use model-scoped anchor like `halcyon7b-compat`.

lint-bot: ERROR docs/models/halcyon-7b.md: anchor "compatibility" already defined in docs/models/vega13b.md line 19.

cara: renamed anchor to `halcyon7b-compat` and pushed.

devon: runtime suggestion: use the exact metric key in docs `kernel.fallback_reason` and list affected variants: `halcyon-7b-q4_cpu`, `halcyon-7b-q4_cpu-smallmap`. Also add a short compatibility sentence: "Streaming: best-effort on q4_cpu; prefer full fp16 for deterministic boundaries and lower tail latency."

cara: added devon's wording and a one-line billing callout: "Hosted customers: per-token billing unchanged but expect higher tail-latency; Dedicated customers may see capacity impacts."

nora: added tiny Python snippet (in PR): `from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='halcyon-7b', input='long prefix...', routing={'prefer_variant':'fp16-full','allow_fallback':True})
if resp.metadata.get('kernel.fallback_reason'): print('fallback used:', resp.metadata['kernel.fallback_reason'])`

nora: added JS streaming example (in PR): `const client=new RedwoodClient(); const stream = await client.stream({model:'halcyon-7b', routing:{prefer_variant:'fp16-full'}}); for await (const chunk of stream) { if (chunk.meta && chunk.meta['kernel.fallback_reason']) console.warn('fallback', chunk.meta['kernel.fallback_reason']); process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }`

docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #6128  https://deploy-preview.docs/6128  view halcyon card under "Compatibility & performance".

lint-bot: re-run: no anchor duplicates. minor markdown warning: line-length in docs/models/halcyon-7b.md line 68.

devon: small runtime follow-up: I'll add a short note in the runtime changelog referencing this card and the `kernel.fallback_reason` metric.

cara: assigning follow-ups: @nora smoke-test snippets, @devon add runtime changelog, @docs-bot merge when green. thanks all :tada:

nora: smoke: Python snippet runs and metadata key present. JS snippet works in Node 18+; adding a one-line note about older Node polyfills. LGTM.

cara: merging now.
